verdict.rationale: Delaware's own pages publish concrete dollar amounts for several transactions. These include the $75 name reservation, the $175 long-form Certificate of Status, the $400 annual tax for LLCs/LPs, and the $200 late penalty plus 1.5% monthly interest. The site also hosts its own filing-fee calculators for new stock entities and a franchise tax calculator, not a contact form. Missing for 10: the base formation filing fee is not quoted as an explicit amount (it is only available through the calculator), there is no complete fee schedule across transaction types in evidence, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of the amounts.
